title: Field of a stack block is read after the region of a try has ended
summary: Inside a `try`, a field read from a stack-allocated block and passed in the raised exception is computed in the handler, after the region of the `try` has ended and the slot has been reused. With a string field the program ends with a segmentation fault; the wrong value can also reach the caller inside the exception.
cause: After Simplify the handler is an ordinary continuation with one use, so `middle_end/flambda2/to_cmm` inlines it and holds the pure read across `End_try_region`; the flush in `to_cmm_expr.ml` is done for `End_region` only.

fix.text: Flushes delayed bindings at `End_try_region` as at `End_region`. Builds; `test.ml` then prints the expected result; testsuite unchanged.

reference: related: issue #4803 (a call moved after a load; not the same)
